name: migrate-camoufox-to-argus
title: Migrate Camoufox fetch transport to argus service
description: Replace the in-repo Camoufox sidecar (camoufox/server.py) with calls to the standalone argus service (../argus). Point fetch-page.ts/extract-image.ts at ARGUS_BASE_URL with bearer auth; adopt argus's blocked-signature classification (reason=blocked + signature + retryable) and delete iris's blocked-signatures.ts + isBlockedSignatureRetryable retry helper. Retry/backoff/pLimit stays in iris.
creator: Howard Ju
